title: Disable a LEFT/RIGHT Tipper and Verify Solid Blue Stacklight on VISU_MANCONTROL
summary: On the Operator Station HMI screen VISU_MANCONTROL, disable the corresponding LEFT or RIGHT tipper using the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button and verify the corresponding stacklight illuminates solid blue.
when_to_use: Use when you need to disable a specific LEFT or RIGHT tipper from the Operator Station HMI and confirm the expected stacklight indication (solid blue) on VISU_MANCONTROL.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the VISU_MANCONTROL manual disable action for the selected LEFT/RIGHT tipper and verify the corresponding stacklight state.
safety_notes: If the stacklight does not illuminate solid blue after pressing the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button, stop and escalate.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (Operator Station HMI) access to the VISU_MANCONTROL screen
Visual access to the corresponding tipper stacklight

visual_references.description: VISU_MANCONTROL screen showing the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE buttons and the related stacklight behavior (solid blue).

steps.title: Open VISU_MANCONTROL (Operator Station HMI manual control screen)
steps.purpose: Access the manual control screen that contains the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE buttons and the associated stacklight indication.
steps.instruction: Open the Operator Station HMI maintenance manual control screen named VISU_MANCONTROL.
steps.expected_result: The VISU_MANCONTROL screen is displayed with the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE controls visible.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button(s) on VISU_MANCONTROL.
steps.failure_condition: VISU_MANCONTROL is not accessible or the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE controls are not visible.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-23: Operator Station HMI Manual Control Screen includes Item 7 LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button.

steps.title: Disable the correct LEFT or RIGHT tipper using the DISABLE button
steps.purpose: Disable the selected tipper so the corresponding stacklight indicates the disabled state.
steps.instruction: Select the correct side (LEFT or RIGHT) and press the corresponding LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button on VISU_MANCONTROL.
steps.expected_result: The corresponding tipper is disabled as indicated by the stacklight behavior described for the DISABLE button.
steps.healthy_condition: After pressing the correct LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button, the corresponding tipper stacklight transitions to the expected solid blue state (verified in the next step).
steps.failure_condition: You press the wrong side or the stacklight does not transition to solid blue after the disable action.

actions.label: Press LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE
actions.exact_action: Press the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Item 7: The LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button will disable the corresponding tipper.

source_evidence.summary: LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button disables the corresponding tipper; stacklight illuminates solid blue.

steps.title: Verify the corresponding tipper stacklight illuminates solid blue
steps.purpose: Confirm the disable action produced the expected physical indication.
steps.instruction: Observe the corresponding tipper stacklight and confirm it illuminates solid blue.
steps.expected_result: The corresponding tipper stacklight illuminates solid blue.
steps.healthy_condition: Stacklight is solid blue for the tipper whose DISABLE button was pressed.
steps.failure_condition: Stacklight does not illuminate solid blue after pressing the DISABLE button.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the stacklight does not illuminate solid blue after pressing the DISABLE button.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Item 7: The stacklight will illuminate solid blue.

source_evidence.summary: LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button disables the corresponding tipper; stacklight illuminates solid blue.

success_criteria: After pressing the LEFT or RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button, the corresponding tipper stacklight illuminates solid blue.
healthy_conditions: Corresponding tipper stacklight is solid blue after the matching LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button press.
failure_conditions: Corresponding tipper stacklight does not illuminate solid blue after pressing the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if the stacklight does not turn solid blue after the disable action.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: VISU_MANCONTROL screen showing the LEFT/RIGHT TIPPER DISABLE button(s) (Item 7) and the described stacklight solid blue indication.

missing_details: The source does not specify whether the stacklight indication is shown only physically or also reflected on-screen; the procedure assumes visual observation of the physical stacklight as stated in the candidate.
